source: 外研社必修第三册 Unit 5 同主题完形(出发前的急救/船长回忆录/登山准备/洞穴探险/沙漠穿越/少年独自航海)。用词限 U5/初中/常见词,答案唯一,同词性,与阅读/听力关不撞文章。部分空考过去将来时(would/was going to)。

passages.title: First Aid Before an Adventure
passages.text: Before you set out on an adventure, it is wise to learn some simple first aid. A good first aid (1)____ should always be packed. If an insect (2)____ becomes hot and red, wash the area with some liquid medicine and try to (3)____ it down. For a bad cut, press on it with a clean (4)____ until the (5)____ stops, and then clean the wound with fresh water or (6)____. If someone breaks an arm, place an ice (7)____ on it to reduce the (8)____, and keep the arm still. In hot weather, watch for heatstroke: take the person to a cool place and use a (9)____ to check the temperature. Knowing what to (10)____ in these moments can keep a small problem from becoming a big one.

questions.explanation: first aid kit 急救包。
insect bite 昆虫叮咬处。
cool it down 使其降温。
a clean cloth 干净的布。
the bleeding stops 止血。
water or alcohol 清水或酒精。
an ice pack 冰袋。
reduce the pain 减轻疼痛。
use a thermometer 用体温计。
what to do 该做什么。

passages.title: The Captain's Memoir
passages.text: It was spring, and we were sailing from (1)____. We were excited, and none of us knew that these (2)____ be our final days together. At first the waters were (3)____, and we spent our time fishing and playing cards, happily (4)____ that a great storm was near. The captain later wrote in his (5)____ that the trip (6)____ change all our lives. Hours later, huge waves (7)____ over the ship, breaking it in two and throwing us into the sea. Choking with water, we swam to the nearest (8)____. There we sat on the (9)____, cold and frightened, already making plans to (10)____. None of us would forget that terrible night.

questions.explanation: sail from port 从港口起航。
none of us knew(过去)+ 结局未发生 → 过去将来 would be。
the waters were calm 海面平静。
happily unaware 浑然不觉。
wrote in his diary 写在日记里。
wrote(过去)、改变尚未发生 → would change。
waves rose over the ship 巨浪涌上船。
the nearest island 最近的岛。
sat on the shore 坐在岸边。
plans to escape 逃生的计划。

passages.title: Getting Ready for the Mountain
passages.text: Climbing a high mountain takes months of (1)____. Long before the trip, climbers train hard to get used to thin air and low (2)____. They study maps and plan each (3)____ along the route, so that they can rest and sleep on the way up. Good gear matters too: a warm coat, strong boots and a thick (4)____ to protect the head. The (5)____ checks the weather every day, because a sudden storm can (6)____ a safe climb into a deadly one. Near the top lies the death (7)____, where the body can only last a few (8)____. Most climbers know that the journey (9)____ both body and mind. Yet, when they finally stand on the (10)____, they feel that every hard day was worth it.

questions.explanation: months of preparation 数月准备。
low oxygen 低氧。
plan each camp 规划每个营地。
a thick helmet 厚头盔。
the guide checks 向导查看。
turn … into … 把……变成……。
the death zone 死亡地带。
a few days 几天。
know 此处转述过去判断,旅程考验在将来 → would test。
stand on the summit 站上峰顶。

passages.title: Into the Cave
passages.text: Last summer I joined a small team to explore a deep (1)____ in the mountains. We each wore a helmet with a bright (2)____, because no sunlight could reach so far below the (3)____. Step by step we climbed down into the (4)____, and the air grew cold and wet. Our guide warned us that the path ahead (5)____ slippery, so we moved slowly and held the rope (6)____. Deep inside, we found a huge room whose walls (7)____ us like a stone castle. The silence there was so complete that it almost (8)____ me. We were going to go even (9)____, but our guide said it was getting late, so we turned back. It was the most (10)____ adventure I had ever had.

questions.explanation: a deep cave 深洞。
a bright light 明亮的灯。
below the ground 地面之下。
into the dark 进入黑暗。
warned us(过去)、前路情况尚未到 → would be。
held the rope tightly 紧紧抓绳。
walls surrounded us 墙壁围着我们。
almost astonished me 几乎让我吃惊。
go deeper 往更深处。
the most amazing adventure 最精彩的冒险。

passages.title: Crossing the Desert
passages.text: Crossing a great desert is one of the hardest (1)____ in the world. By day the sun is so strong that travellers must (2)____ their heads, and by night the air turns surprisingly (3)____. Long ago, traders rode camels across the sand, carrying salt, cloth and (4)____ for many weeks. A camel can go for days without (5)____, which made it the perfect animal for such a (6)____. The travellers followed the stars at night, because there were no roads to (7)____ them. They knew the trip (8)____ dangerous, but the riches waiting at the end were worth the (9)____. Even today, a few brave people still cross the desert to feel the same sense of (10)____ that those early traders once knew.

questions.explanation: the hardest adventures 最艰难的冒险。
cover their heads 遮住头部。
turns cold 变冷。
carrying water 携带饮水。
without drinking 不喝水。
such a journey 这样的旅程。
no roads to guide them 没有路指引。
knew(过去)、危险尚在前路 → would be。
worth the risk 值得冒险。
a sense of freedom 自由感。

passages.title: My First Solo Sail
passages.text: When I was sixteen, I made my first solo sailing trip, and I will never (1)____ it. My father, who was a sailor, told me that the sea (2)____ me more than any school. questions.explanation: never forget it 永远忘不了。
told me(过去)、教导发生在将来 → would teach。
first aid 急救。
calm and bright 平静明朗。
along the coast 沿海岸。
clouds gather 乌云聚集。
过去看即将发生的事 → was going to hit;现在 is going to/will 视角错。

felt proud 感到自豪。
courage grows 勇气增长。
